description: Reassemble a raw streamed LLM API response (server-sent events) into the message it adds up to: text, reasoning, tool calls with parsed arguments, stop reason and token usage. Understands Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Chat Completions (and compatible providers), OpenAI Responses, Gemini generateContent and Gemini Interactions. Also reports whether the stream was cut off, tool-argument JSON that never closed, and error events sent after HTTP 200. Use it to debug a captured stream instead of joining fragments by hand.

format.description: The wire format. Leave as "auto" unless the capture is too partial to recognise.

stream.description: The raw response body: SSE text ("data: ..." lines), one JSON chunk per line, or a JSON array of chunks.

name: llm_stream_assemble
title: Assemble a streamed LLM response
